trade.text: His campaign opposes tariffs and says it favors free trade.
trade.quote: Government should not distort markets or punish consumers through policies like tariffs.

wages.text: He called for wages that let families live and said he would defend workers’ right to organize.
wages.quote: I will fight for wages that let families live, not just scrape by... The right to organize is not a relic. It is how working people hold power. I will always defend it.

schools.text: He pledged to protect public school funding and teachers and opposed diverting public funds to private vouchers.
schools.quote: I will fight to protect public school funding, support our teachers, and make sure that when families pay taxes for education, those dollars actually reach the classroom.

abortion.text: He said abortion and other health care decisions belong to women and their doctors, not politicians.
abortion.quote: Women deserve equal pay and full control over their own healthcare decisions. That is between a woman and her doctor. Not a politician and a lobbyist.

tax.text: His campaign says he supported eliminating taxes on tips and overtime and supported strengthening the Child Tax Credit.
tax.quote: Supported and helped advance eliminating taxes on tips and overtime so working Utahns keep more of what they earn

debt.text: He supports considering cost-cutting options while maintaining promises to seniors.
debt.quote: Keeping options on the table allows us to explore common-sense solutions to cut costs and uphold our promises to seniors.

housing.text: He said Utah should build housing on public land and lower costs for building materials.
housing.quote: Utah could solve these issues by reducing tariffs and taxes on building materials and by building housing on public land.

schools.text: He said he supports vouchers and other school-choice options.
schools.quote: I support school choice, including voucher programs, tax credits, charter schools, private schools, and home schools.

safety.text: He strongly disagreed with redirecting police funding to community programs.
safety.quote: I support redirecting funds from police departments to community programs. Strongly Disagree

guns.text: His campaign says he has defended the Second Amendment.
guns.quote: Defended the right to life, the Second Amendment, and religious liberty

abortion.text: He described himself as proudly pro-life and said abortion is generally a state issue.
abortion.quote: I am proudly pro-life and believe this is, by and large, a state issue.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He voted yea on final passage of the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act.
gender.quote: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act

health.text: He said he would expand health savings accounts and increase health-care competition.
health.quote: Will increase cost transparency and competition to lower prices and improve care.

energy.text: His campaign says he worked to expand domestic energy production to support Utah jobs and lower costs.
energy.quote: Worked to expand domestic energy production to support Utah jobs and lower costs

voting.text: He strongly disagreed that people should be able to vote without photo identification.
voting.quote: People should be able to vote without photo identification. Strongly Disagree
